claims.text: The only V3 user path is OAuth Access Token through WorkBuddy to OpenConnector POST /mcp and then AccessGrant-authorized Connection Actions.
AccessGrant binds a Connection, stable user or group subject, and reader/operator/custom role, with explicit deny precedence.
There is no top-level MCP navigation in v5.1; browser /mcp routes redirect to /connections/docs while backend POST /mcp remains.
The three canonical source pins are clean and equal to their remote default branches at the recorded observation time.
Public veADK is SDK-only and marchpure/veadk-python is donor-only.
All three exact donor commit IDs resolve and are restricted to selective source-pattern migration.
The V2 Publication branch is quarantined and only generic redaction, idempotency, request-ID, error, and negative-auth patterns may be manually reimplemented.
The published Inspire stable preview still targets v4.8 while two V5 shapes exist but conflict with v5.1 routing.
OpenViking contributes only Profile/directory/resource Knowledge ResourceRefs to Skill Context.
I0 freezes ownership, APIs, schemas, routes, errors, tests, migration rules, and handoffs without claiming feature completion.
